description: This PHP class 'EmbedImages' processes HTML content to embed images by replacing image tags with embedded image data or paths, primarily used for converting or manipulating documentation pages in a static site generator context.

classes.name: EmbedImages
classes.description: A class for embedding images within HTML content in documentation pages, resolving image paths and possibly embedding image data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a Root tree object.

methods.name: embed
methods.description: Replaces image tags in HTML content with embedded or resolved image sources using a callback.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Extracts standard attributes from an tag in HTML.

methods.name: findImage
methods.description: Determines the correct image source path, handling external URLs and local paths, and applies a callback for embedding.
